migration_requirements: Inventory persisted version/admission domains, source-issued and importer-admitted forms separately, plus public clients and actual production callers. Lack of deployed evidence is uncertainty, never permission to erase a protocol.

For hashes, retain exact historical preimage/profile or an explicit versioned verifier. A digest of current mutable state is not a migration of historic admitted arguments, consent, source occurrences or release artifacts.
Credential hashes cannot be bulk rederived without bearer input; use bounded dual verification or deliberate revocation/reissuance. Password KDF migration requires successful verification/reset.
Separate authoring/input admission corrections from persisted-format compatibility. Deliberately corrected unsafe hex, cookie Domain, CSV quote/surrogate forms are not obligations to retain.

Preserve stable receipt/outbox/provider identities across all retained releases and complete retry/reconciliation horizons; drain or retain compatible execution when old evidence is missing. Never mark provider-accepted or unknown work cancelled to ease migration.

Migrate identity/state/fanout writes with proved conditional atomicity at one owner and monotonic fences; stop admissions/in-flight jobs during incompatible restore. Proposed batch/outcome shapes are not preapproved.
Invalidate incompatible private reviews for fresh consent while retaining completed row replay. Do not invent historical app/team/version/expiry or revive cleared drafts.

Version artifact/bundle/manifest framing and keep old exact files/readers. Require actual host/producer/installed closure qualification before native default adoption and retain human HOLD until separately released.

Rollback is a compatible release switch before new jobs or a forward reconciliation after effects, never erasing revocations, replay receipts, immutable files, applied artifacts or original provenance.

Current design prose includes historical implementation disclaimers even where source helpers now exist. Those disclaimers must be read as stage evidence, not automatic proof current implementation is absent or complete.
